system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Returns the enrollment window dates for the current crop season. For your information, my state is dummy_state_8771.

function.name: pmfby_get_season_window
function.description: Returns the enrollment window dates for the current crop season. Enrollment is allowed ONLY within this predefined window. Requires session_token. This tool does NOT enroll the farmer. Fails if no active season window exists or the region is unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

state.description: State for which the season window is queried.

crop_type.description: Crop type for which season window is needed.
